tolerances.acceptance_rule: Every inherited numeric field must satisfy both max_abs and RMS limits over one step and the entire short rollout in both scenarios; every inherited exact and replay-mask limit must pass; the source must complete without a fall; nominal generation clipping must remain zero; deterministic-DR generation clipping must not exceed 2.00% of action elements or 0.86 maximum normalized clip magnitude. Clipping remains reported by scenario and joint. Actuator limits are unchanged.

accepted_design_evidence.decision: The user explicitly accepted the observed deterministic-DR clipping and normalized overshoot for this opt-in interface. The limits are rounded upward only to 2.00% and 0.86; nominal clipping remains disallowed.

scenarios.determinism: The startup-DR patch is sampled from the fixed DR seed. Two fixed validation-only velocity deltas are applied after zero-based control steps 39 and 99 in both source and replay.
scenarios.name: deterministic_nontrivial_dr
